_comment: Changelog shown on updates.html. Newest first is not required — entries are sorted by date at render time. Add entries with the Editor page, or by hand. Tags: added | changed | fixed.

entries.title: Update 73 new Exclusives
entries.body: Added Alien Exclusive pets: Alien Bat, Alien Snail. Cosmic Mantis, Interstellar Dragon, Alien Overseer.

entries.title: Update 73
entries.body: Added Atomic World pets: Atomic Slime, Atomic Rat, Atomic Moth, Atomic Dragon, Nuclear Crab, Nuclear Bloom, Reactor Spider, Core Overlord.
items: Missing clicks amount for Core Overlord, will be added soon.

entries.title: Export sorting, Missing filter
entries.body: Export gained a Rarity sort, and a new Missing filter narrows the table to pets that still need one specific variant.
items: Export sort: Rarity now pools everything in scope by tier instead of by world.
Missing filter: show only pets still missing one variant, from Normal, Golden, Toxic, or Galaxy.
Season Exclusive Egg pets: previously blank egg names and clicks filled in. Thanks oliveboi08!

entries.title: All category
entries.body: Added an All tab that lists every pet from every world and category in one place. New profiles now open on it by default.

entries.title: Export list, keyboard navigation
entries.body: Added a way to export what you're still missing as a plain-text list, and the tick grid now supports full keyboard navigation.
items: Export pets: copy a list of what you still need, scoped to the whole index, one world, or your current filters.
Keyboard navigation: arrow keys, Home/End, and Enter now move focus around the grid.
Profile actions reorganised: Switch profile, Edit profile, Backup/Import, Export pets.

entries.title: Release
entries.body: Every pet in the game is indexed: 1,229 pets across 16 categories, 4,613 variants. Progress saves in your browser under a profile name, no login or account needed.
items: Clicks data is incomplete: 657 of 1,229 pets show a dash instead of a number. Missing data will be added in future updates.
